description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Linked Materia Mode III (Wind, Dark)], [Hardened SOLDIER Mode], Mako Infused +1 and Jenova Injection +1 to the user

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Linked Materia Mode III (Wind, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Dark 2 with Stacking] after using a Wind/Dark ability

description.name: Hardened SOLDIER Mode
description.text: Grants [100% Critical 1] and [Critical Damage +50% 1] to the user after using a Wind or Dark ability, grants [Damage Cap +80000 1]/[Damage Cap +60000 1]/[Damage Cap +40000 1]/[Damage Cap +20000 1] to the user after using 1/2/3/4 Wind or Dark abilities, removed after triggering four times
